On Facebook, accounts reached fall to 787.344 (-63%), views to 1.699.133 (-50%), interactions to 90.911 (-25%) and clicks to 10.833 (-41%).

Management included daily monitoring of spend, selection of placements and creative rotation to limit audience fatigue.
Work on balancing Instagram and Facebook continued according to the return of each placement.
